column3: Sends the prize money news to the club's human manager, only when the prize is at least 50 × the club reputation: the competition, the amount, the position, the round, the kind and, with the fixture, the opponent and whether the club won. \n `Comp::send_prize_money_news(club, amount (i64), position, round, fixture, kind)`, ret 0x1c; SEH frame only for the local news item. To the club's human manager (`club_has_human_manager`), with an amount of at least 50 × the reputation (`.reputation()`), news 0x1a (`exe::new_newsitem`): 0 the competition (`[this+4]`), 1 the amount, 2 the club, 3 the position, 4 the round, 7 the kind; with the fixture, 5 the opponent and 6 whether the club won (`.home_result_mark()`/`.away_result_mark()` the penalty shoot-out winner [inference], otherwise `.home_aggregate()`/`.away_aggregate()`, otherwise `.home_goals()`/`.away_goals()` the score); without it, −1 and 0. Delivered to him (`exe::news_send_to_club_manager`).

Sends the TV rights news to the club's human manager: the club, the competition, the amount and the year. \n `Comp::send_tv_rights_news(club, value)`, ret 8; SEH frame only for the local news item. To the club's human manager (`club_has_human_manager`), news 0x1f (`exe::new_newsitem`): 0 the club, 1 the competition (`.competition()`), 2 the amount, 3 the competition year (`.year()`), delivered to him (`exe::news_send_to_club_manager`).

In the top competition, tells whether it and every competition down the chain are complete. \n Ret 0, method +0xc of the competitions: `Comp::all_stages_complete()`: only in the top competition (`.upper_division_id()` ≤ −1), it and each one in the chain below (`league::LOWER_DIVISION_ID`, the index into `[G_COMP_OBJECT_TABLE]`) must be complete (`comp_vtable::CHECK_COMPLETE` with 1, 1: push 1; push 1; mov ecx -> thiscall, ret 8); returns 1 or 0 (in al).

Builds the vector of the distinct clubs of all stages (up to 200) and returns the count. \n Ret 8, method +0x58 of the competitions: `Comp::collect_club_list(&list, _)`: a vector of 200 pointers (`exe::crt_malloc`(0x320); out of memory: the box at line 0x681, a null list and 0) with the distinct clubs of all stages (−1 the competition itself up to `.current_stage()`; the others in `.stages()`): in a league (`league::COMP_TYPE` = 2) those of table `league::TABLE` (rows of `league_table_row::SIZE` bytes), otherwise those of `cup::TEAM_TABLE` (6 bytes), skipping null and repeated ones, up to 200; stores the vector in `list` and returns the count (word, in ax).

Finds the stage id, the status and the round the club reached, searching from the last stage back. \n Ret 0x10: `Comp::find_club_progress(club, &stage_id, &round, &status)`: over the stages from the last (`.current_stage()`) to the first (−1 the competition itself; the others in `.stages()`), skipping those with id (`league::STAGE_ID`) 0x3fc: in a league (`league::COMP_TYPE` = 2), the club's table row (`exe::league_get_table_row` push i; mov ecx, stage -> thiscall, ret 4): stage_id = the id (`league::STAGE_ID`) and status = `league_table_row::STATUS` of the row, and returns; in a cup, the last team of table `cup::TEAM_TABLE` (6 bytes) that is the club gives stage_id = the id (`cup::STAGE_LABEL`) and status = +5, and the round is the first round (from `cup::CURRENT_ROUND` − 1 backwards, `cup::ROUND_TABLE` with `cup_round::SIZE` (0x68) bytes, the ties of `cup::TIE_TABLES` with 0x35 bytes) with a tie in which the team plays (+0 or +2): round = +7 of the round, and returns.

From the given stage backwards, returns the index of the first stage of the same group. \n Ret 4: `Comp::get_first_stage_of_group(k)`, used by the competition screens (0x4947a0): from stage `k` backwards, while the stages have the same group (`exe::comp_util_get_parent_stage_id` of the id `league::STAGE_ID`: push id; add esp, 4 -> cdecl) and the index is greater than −1, the index of the first of them (k itself when it has no group).

Returns the first stage not finished (for a cup not yet started, the start of its group); with all finished, the start of the last one's group. \n Ret 0: `Comp::get_current_stage()`, used by the competition screens (0x48f8e0): the first stage (−1 the competition itself, up to `.current_stage()`) that has not finished (`comp_vtable::CHECK_COMPLETE` with (0, 1) = 0); if it is a cup (`league::COMP_TYPE` = 1) that has not started (`cup::CURRENT_ROUND` = 0), goes back to the start of its group through the previous stage (`exe::comp_util_get_parent_stage_id` and `exe::comp_get_stage`: push k; mov ecx, this -> thiscall, ret 4). All finished: the start of the last one's group. Invalid stage at the end: the box at line 0x36e and the competition itself; null stage: the competition itself.
forwards the match importance query to the fixture's stage (`fixture::STAGE_INDEX`; virtual `comp_vtable::GET_MATCH_IMPORTANCE`)

Returns the active key of the key nation that owns the fixture: by the competition's nation, by the nations of the clubs in a friendly, 0 for the World Cup, 1 for national side tournaments. \n `comp_active_key_nation_of_fixture(comp, fixture)`, the key of the FIXTURE_MANAGER match lists (add_fixture `add_fixture`, find_fixtures `find_fixtures`, ...), of the quick simulation (`exe::match_day_can_quick_simulate`) and of the FIFA ranking weight (`exe::fifa_rankings_record_match_result`). Friendly (`exe::friendly_is_friendly_competition` over `[G_FRIENDLY]`) or reserves (`[KEY_CLUB_COMP_RESERVE]`) with the given fixture and its competition being the friendly one (`[G_FRIENDLY]`+4) or the reserves one: with either side a national side (`exe::database_is_national_team` of the clubs `.home_club()`/`.away_club()`), 1; different nations (`.nation()`) or outside the selection (`.league_selected()`), 3; the nation in the table of the 35 key nations (`G_LEAGUE_TABLE`, 72 bytes each, selected in `.league_selected()`), byte +0x14 of the row; otherwise 0 with the home side a national side and 3 without. Otherwise, a nation's competition (`.nation()`): byte +0x14 of its row, or 3. Without a nation: World Cup and qualifiers (`exe::key_nation_is_world_cup_comp`), 0; international tournament (`exe::key_nation_is_international_comp`), 1; otherwise the key nation index (`exe::key_nation_index_of_comp`). TapeCall on every fixture searched: no counter.

Tells whether a round's fixtures are known: the stage is a league, or the round is before the current one, or it is the current last round with code 0x8c. \n Ret 8: `Comp::are_round_fixtures_known(stage, round)`: the stage (−1 = the competition itself; above `.current_stage()`: 0; below −1: the box at line 0x36e, as in the original) is a league (`.comp_type()` = `comp_type::LEAGUE`): 1. Otherwise 1 if the round is before the current one (`.current_round()`, byte) or is the current one, the last (`.round_count()` − 1) and with code 0x8c (+7 of its 0x68-byte record in `.round_table()`); otherwise 0.

Returns 1 when the match round (`fixture::ROUND_NAME`) ends in 0 or is 1000 or above, else 0. \n Ret 8: `Comp::counts_for_fixture_clash(game, other)` (virtual +0x60 of the competitions, used by the date clash check `collect_day_clashes`): 1 if the units digit (`exe::comp_util_get_round_variant`) of the round (`fixture::ROUND_NAME`, signed) is 0 (a round of 1000 or more also gives 0), otherwise 0. `other` is not read.

rule: the Emperor's Cup takes 80 clubs: 47 from the regional divisions ([`KEY_CLUB_COMP_JAPANESE_ADMINISTRATIVE_DIVISION`], sorted by reputation and shuffled), 2 from the university league ([`KEY_CLUB_COMP_JAPANESE_UNIVERSITY_LEAGUE`] [inference]), 3 from the football league ([`KEY_CLUB_COMP_JAPANESE_FOOTBALL_LEAGUE`] [inference]) — those drawn from other Japanese divisions (up to 6) do not enter —, the J2 clubs (class 0) and the J1 clubs with class = last season's position; the last 16 entries are sorted by class; if the lower divisions lack clubs, the error box

rule: eight clubs. Two from Mexico (drawn among the 6 with the highest reputation), three from Central America (nation region 7, other than nation [`KEY_NATION_UNITED_STATES`]; among the top 9), one from the Caribbean (region 6; among the top 3) and two from the United States: with competition [`KEY_CLUB_COMP_US_OPEN_CUP`] running [inference: the US Open Cup], the latest MLS champion and its champion (if the same club, the place goes to the MLS runner-up); without it, two MLS clubs among the top 3 by reputation. Up to 200 clubs per region and 12 from the MLS are considered

Daily update of the CONCACAF Champions' Cup. Rule: on the first day of the cup season (empty team table), picks the qualified clubs and the predicted positions; every day, the cup update (draws and matches). \n Ret 8; virtual +0x14 of the cup: `ConChamp::update_for_date(today, stage)`. With the team table empty (the club of team 0 of `.team_table()` = 0) and stage ≠ 0: the qualified clubs (`exe::conchamp_select_qualified_clubs`: mov ecx, this -> thiscall, ret 0; negative: the box at line 0x1ba and returns 0) and the predicted positions (`comp_vtable::SET_PREDICTED_POSITIONS`). Then the cup update (`exe::cup_update_for_date`: push stage; push today; mov ecx, this -> thiscall, ret 8), whose return value is returned.

Sets up the rounds of the CONCACAF Champions' Cup. Rule: the cup prize fund is 2,000,000; the round table (three-round knockout) comes from `comp_vtable::CREATE_SCHEDULE`. \n Ret 0; virtual +0x8c: `ConChamp::set_up_rounds()`; returns 1. The prize fund (`.set_prize_fund()`) of 2,000,000 and the round table (`.set_round_table()`) from `comp_vtable::CREATE_SCHEDULE` (push 0; push &`cup::STAGE_LABEL`; push &`cup::ROUND_COUNT`; push −1; mov ecx, this -> thiscall, ret 0x10).

Creates the round table of the CONCACAF Champions' Cup. Rule: 8 teams in single matches: quarter-finals drawn on 1/8 and played on 28/8, semi-final on 1/9 and final on 4/9; category 8, tie-break 3; no per-round prize (−1). \n Ret 0x10; virtual +0x3c: `ConChamp::create_round_table(stage, &rounds, &extra, &out)`: at stage −1, out (if requested) = 0, rounds = 3, extra = 0; the table (`exe::crt_malloc` of 0x138; out of memory: the box at line 0x97 and 0) with the 3 rounds and, in the first two, day 0 of the empty tie (`exe::cup_set_round_match_day` with −1, −1, −1 and home 0; the original calls it between the match and the fields, which do not overlap). Outside −1, 0.

Rule: the Oceania Club Championship is drawn on the start day (`.next_draw_day()`/`.next_draw_year_offset()`) and only on the call without `full`: the 8 clubs, the predicted positions, group A in the cup's own table, the fixtures and group B as a stage; before that day the cup does not even run the league day; an error while building returns 1 without the league day. \n `today.update_for_date(full)` (virtual +0x14; SEH frame only for the local dates, no destructor): the Oceania Club Championship's day. The draw date is that of 0x549ef0(`.next_draw_day()`, `.next_draw_year_offset()` + `.year()`) (lea ecx, local; push year; push day -> thiscall, ret 8, pure). Before it (today's year lower, unsigned; or the same year and today's day lower, signed) the routine returns 0 without the league day. On the draw day, if the draw is not done (`.active()` = 0) and WITHOUT `full`: the 8 clubs (`exe::oceaniaclubchamp_select_qualified_clubs`: mov ecx -> thiscall, ret 0), the predicted positions (`comp_vtable::SET_PREDICTED_POSITIONS`, thiscall, ret 0), the group A table (`exe::oceaniaclubchamp_create_group_a_table`, thiscall, ret 0; 0: the error box at line 0x21d), the fixtures (`exe::league_create_fixtures` League::create_fixtures, thiscall, ret 0; 0: the error box at line 0x224), the sorted table (`exe::league_sort_table` push 0; mov ecx -> thiscall, ret 4; 0: the error box at line 0x22b) (an error returns 1, without the league day), the group B stage (`exe::oceaniaclubchamp_create_group_b_stage`, thiscall, ret 0), the list `oceania_club_champ::DRAWN_CLUBS` freed (`exe::crt_free`: push; add esp, 4 -> cdecl) and zeroed, `oceania_club_champ::DRAWN_CLUB_COUNT` = 0 and `.set_active(1)`. Then the league day (`exe::league_update_for_date`: push full; push today; mov ecx, this -> thiscall, ret 8), whose return value it passes on.

Rule: group A of the Oceania Club Championship has the first 4 chosen clubs, each in the row of its order; human managers get the group draw news. \n `OceaniaClubChamp::create_group_a_table()`: 4 teams (`.set_club_count()`), the table (`.set_table()`; `exe::crt_malloc`(0xec): push 0xec; add esp, 4 -> cdecl; 4 rows of 0x3b bytes; out of memory, the error box at line 0x182 and returns 0), each row i with chosen club i (`selected_club`) (`exe::league_init_table_row` League::init_table_row: push 0; push 0; push club; push i; mov ecx, this -> thiscall, ret 0x10), the group draw news (`exe::league_send_group_draw_news`: mov ecx, this -> thiscall, ret 0) and returns 1. The same body as `init_group_a_table` of the African Cup (only the file and the error box line change).

Rule: group B of the Oceania Club Championship is a league stage with chosen clubs 4 to 7, the cup's rules and year and the cup's round table for stage 0 (10, 12 and 14 January); human managers get the news. \n `OceaniaClubChamp::create_group_b_stage()` (SEH frame only for the stage's new: no destructor on the normal path): the teams in a vector of 4 pointers (`exe::crt_malloc`(0x10): push; add esp, 4 -> cdecl; out of memory, the error box at line 0x296 and 0): chosen clubs 4 to 7 (`selected_club`); the round table through `comp_vtable::CREATE_SCHEDULE` (push 0; push &id; push &rounds; push 0; mov ecx, this -> thiscall, ret 0x10); the stage (`exe::crt_operator_new`(0xee) push; add esp, 4 -> cdecl; the League_Stage constructor `FN_LEAGUE_STAGE_LEAGUE_STAGE`, thiscall, ret 0x58, 22 arguments: the cup, 4, the vector, 1, `.competition()`, the round table, the rounds (word), `.win_points()`, `.draw_points()`, `.match_category()`, &`league::TIEBREAKS`, &`league::PROMOTED_COUNT`, the year `.year()` (word), 0, the id (word), `.importance()`, 2, 0, `.league_flags()` (word), −1, 0, 2; the original pushes the words and bytes with garbage in the high bytes, which the constructor does not read: the copy passes clean values) into `.stages()`[0]; the vector and the round table freed (`exe::crt_free`). No stage: the error box at line 0x2ad and 0. With it: `.set_current_stage(0)`, the group news (`exe::league_send_group_draw_news` on the stage) and 1.

Rule: the Oceania Club Championship semi-finals cross the groups: A winner × B runner-up and A runner-up × B winner, in a cup stage (stage 1) with the first round set up at once. \n `OceaniaClubChamp::create_knockout_stage()` (SEH frame only for the stage's new: no destructor on the normal path), the semi-finals: the list of the 4 (`exe::crt_malloc`(0x10): push; add esp, 4 -> cdecl; out of memory, the error box at line 0x2cb and return), the semi-finalist pairings (`semifinalists`); the round table through `comp_vtable::CREATE_SCHEDULE` (push 0; push &id; push &rounds; push 1; mov ecx, this -> thiscall, ret 0x10); the stage (`exe::crt_operator_new`(0xb2) push; add esp, 4 -> cdecl; Cup_Stage::Cup_Stage `FN_CUP_STAGE_CUP_STAGE`, thiscall, ret 0x3c: the cup, 4, the list, the rounds, `.competition()`, the table, the year `.year()`, 1, 2, the id, 0x14, 0, 0, 0 and no seed; the original pushes the rounds, the id and the year with garbage in the high 16 bits, which the constructor does not read) into `.stages()`[1]; the table and the list freed (`exe::crt_free`). No stage: the error box at line 0x2e3 and return. With it: the round set up (`exe::cup_set_up_round` Cup::set_up_round: push 0; mov ecx, stage -> thiscall, ret 4).

Builds the Series A table: 28 clubs, those whose national division is Series A, in database order; when full, TV pays 150,000 to each club (no prize fund). \n `BraNatFirst::create_table()`: Series A has 28 clubs (those with national division +0x57 = `[KEY_CLUB_COMP_BRAZILIAN_NATIONAL_FIRST_DIVISION]`); when full, TV pays 150,000 to each club (League::pay_tv_rights `exe::league_pay_tv_rights`: push 0; push 0x249f0; mov ecx, edi -> thiscall(league, amount, filter), ret 8; it sends the TV news) and returns 1. Source 0x98aa30, line 0x1a1.

Creates the Series C final: the winner of third-round group A against the winner of group B, in a two-club cup stage [inference: home and away]; the winner is the Series C champion. \n SEH frame only for the `new`. `BraNatThird::create_final_stage()`, the Series C final, called at the end of the third round: the champions of the two third-round groups (the first of stage 8's table and that of stage 9, in that order; `stage_leader`) in a local list of 2; the round table through `comp_vtable::CREATE_SCHEDULE` (create_round_table: thiscall(this, 10, &rounds, &extra, 0), ret 0x10); the stage (operator new `exe::crt_operator_new`(0xb2) and the Cup_Stage constructor `FN_CUP_STAGE_CUP_STAGE`, thiscall, ret 0x3c: the league, 2, the list, the rounds, `.competition()`, the table, the year, 10, 1, the extra, 0x14, 0, 0, 0, null seeds; clean words) into `.stages()`[10]. Without a stage: the error box at line 0x392 and it returns (without freeing the table). With one: the table freed (free `exe::crt_free`) and `.set_current_stage(10)`. [inference] The final decides the Series C champion, home and away.

The Series C season turnover: archives the season, clears the table, the schedule and the stages, moves to the next year and rebuilds the rules, the 56-club list and the table, the fixtures and the order; then the board expectations, the referee renewal, the seven first-round groups and the predicted positions; the 56-club list is discarded at the end. \n `BraNatThird::start_new_season()`, the Series C turnover (called from the Series A turnover): `league::SEASON_CLOSED` = 0 and the table freed (League::free_table `exe::league_free_table`, thiscall(this, 0), ret 4); the schedule (`league::ROUND_DATES`) freed (free `exe::crt_free`) and cleared; with statistics (`league::COMP_STATS`), Comp_Stats::archive_season_and_reset (`exe::comp_stats_archive_season_and_reset`, thiscall(stats, 1), ret 4); with the current stage ≥ 0, the existing stages 0..=`.current_stage()` are destroyed (virtual 0, the destructor with 1); `league::CURRENT_STAGE` = −1; the stage array freed; the year (`league::YEAR`, word) goes up by one; a new array of `.stage_count()` stages (malloc of 4 × `.stage_count()`, not cleared; with `.stage_count()` ≤ 0, null) into `league::STAGES`; then, each with its own error box (lines 0x202, 0x209, 0x20f and 0x216) if it returns 0: the rules (`comp_vtable::SET_UP_RULES`), the table and the list of the 56 (`exe::branatthird_create_table`, thiscall, ret 0), the fixtures (League::create_fixtures `exe::league_create_fixtures`) and the table order (League::sort_table `exe::league_sort_table`, thiscall(this, 0), ret 4); finally the boards' expectations (League::set_club_season_expectations `exe::league_set_club_season_expectations`, thiscall, ret 0), the referee renewal (OfficialsManager::renew_officials `exe::officialsmanager_renew_officials`, thiscall(`[G_OFFICIALS_MANAGER]`, `league::COMPETITION`), ret 4), the seven first-round groups (`exe::branatthird_create_group_stage`(g), thiscall, ret 4, g from 0 to 6), the predicted positions (`comp_vtable::SET_PREDICTED_POSITIONS`) and the list of the 56 (`bra_nat_third::CLUB_LIST`) freed (if present) and cleared. With an error box, the copy returns 0 (the original returns the box's eax, which the Brazilian turnover does not read); at the end, the eax of the free or `bra_nat_third::CLUB_LIST` (the copy returns 0: nobody reads it).

Sets the Series C predicted positions: the 56 ordered by reputation; the favourite 1st, the second 2nd, the next two 3rd (the semi-finals), two 5th and two 7th, eight 9th (the second round) and the other forty in bands of eight: 16th, 24th, 32nd, 40th and 48th. \n `BraNatThird::set_predicted_positions()`, called from the constructor and the turnover, after the groups. Without statistics (+8): the error box at line 0x4a2 and it returns. The list of the 56 (`bra_nat_third::CLUB_LIST`) is sorted in place by reputation (qsort `exe::crt_qsort` with 0x4b07d0, highest first, nulls at the end) and each club, in order, gets the predicted position from `place_for_index` (Comp_Stats::set_club_final_position `exe::comp_stats_set_club_final_position`, thiscall(+8, club, position), ret 8; the original pushes the band of the forty in a dword with the band's byte and stack garbage above it; `set_club_final_position` reads only the byte: the copy passes the clean byte).

Creates the Series C second round: the sixteen (the top two of each group) seeded by first-round points (ties go to the earlier one: the league, then groups 0 to 6, first before second), in a knockout where the best meets the 16th, the 2nd the 15th and so on [inference: pairs follow the list]. 
 SEH frame only for the `new`. `BraNatThird::create_second_round_stage()`, the Series C second round, called at the end of the groups. 
 1) A list of 16 (malloc `exe::crt_malloc` of 0x40; out of memory: the error box at line 0x2e6 and it returns). 
 2) The top two of each of the eight groups (the league's table `league::TABLE` and those of stages 0 to 6, in that order), in 6-byte records (the club and the points, the row's `league_table_row::POINTS`). 
 3) Sixteen times: the record with most points (the first one, on a tie) among those that still have a club is taken out (the club becomes 0) and the club goes to slot `SECOND_ROUND_SEEDS[k]`: the best against the 16th, the 2nd against the 15th... (with none left: the error box at line 0x30b; the original then reads address 0 and crashes). 
 4) The round table through `comp_vtable::CREATE_SCHEDULE` (thiscall(this, 7, &rounds, &extra, 0), ret 0x10); the stage (operator new `exe::crt_operator_new`(0xb2) and the Cup_Stage constructor `FN_CUP_STAGE_CUP_STAGE`, thiscall, ret 0x3c: the league, 16, the list, the rounds, `.competition()`, the table, the year, 7, 1, the extra, 0x14, 0, 0, 0, null seeds; clean words) into `.stages()`[7]. Without a stage: the error box at line 0x31b and it returns. With one: the table and the list freed (free `exe::crt_free`) and `.set_current_stage(7)`.

Creates the Series C third round: the eight second-round winners, drawn (shuffled) into two groups of four, home and away, with 3 points for a win, 1 for a draw, tie-breakers {1, 2, 4} and two top places in each group [inference: the top two of each group go up to Series B and the group winners play the final]. \n SEH frame only for the `new`. `BraNatThird::create_third_round_groups()`, the Series C third round, called at the end of the second: the second-round winners (`.stages()`[7], the 6-byte records of `.team_table()` with +5 = 1, in order) in a local list of 8, shuffled (`exe::comp_util_shuffle_pointer_array`, cdecl(v, 8)); the first four form group A (stage 8) and the other four group B (stage 9). Each group: the round table through `comp_vtable::CREATE_SCHEDULE` (thiscall(this, 8 or 9, &rounds, &extra, 0)) and the stage (operator new `exe::crt_operator_new`(0xee) and the League_Stage constructor `FN_LEAGUE_STAGE_LEAGUE_STAGE`: the league, 4, the list (or the list + 4), 2 (home and away), `.competition()`, the table, the rounds (word), 3 points per win, 1 per draw, category 5, &{1,2,4,0} (the tie-break criteria), &{2,0,0,0} (two top places), the year, 8 or 9, the extra (word), 0x14, 1, 0, 2 (the rule bits), −1, 0, 2) into `.stages()`[8] or `[9]`; without a stage: the error box at line 0x353 or 0x363 and it returns; with one, the table freed (free `exe::crt_free`). After the second one, `.set_current_stage(9)`. [inference] The top two of each group go up to Series B; the group winners play the final.

Builds the Series C table: up to 56 clubs (those of the division, in database order), which are drawn (3 swaps per club); the first 7 of the draw make the first table, of 7 clubs, and the drawn list is kept for the other groups [inference: 8 groups of 7 in the first stage]. \n `BraNatThird::create_table()`: `.set_club_count(7)`; the list of entrants (`bra_nat_third::CLUB_LIST`) is rebuilt (the old one freed, `exe::crt_free` push; add esp -> cdecl; the new one with 0xe0 bytes = 56 pointers; out of memory: the error box at line 0x18f and it returns 1, as the original); the table (`.set_table()`, 7 × 0x3b; out of memory: the error box at line 0x196 and 0); the list receives, in database order, up to 56 clubs whose division (`club::DIVISION`) is Series C itself (the record in `.competition()`); the list is shuffled (`exe::comp_util_shuffle_pointer_array`: push count (word); push list; add esp, 8 -> cdecl; 3 × count random swaps) and the first 7 of the draw go into rows 0..6 (`exe::league_init_table_row`, the row in a clean dword). Source 0x98aba4. Returns 1.

Ends the financial season for the clubs of a key nation: after the game start date, for each club with a league and an active nation or reputation 5000 whose row is the given key nation, the club's season end runs, and the season totals (`finance::SEASON_PLAYERS_BOUGHT`) move to last season (`finance::LAST_SEASON_TOTALS`) and are cleared; stops at the first national team club. \n The asserts cite finance.CPP. `FinanceTable::end_season_for_nation(entry)`, called from the season loop (0x5d5ae0, on the day before the season start of the key nation `entry` of table 0xb63d60, 72 bytes each). Nothing before the game start date (`[G_GAME_START_DATE]` after today, `exe::date_operator_3c`: ecx = `G_CURRENT_DATE`; 2 pushes; no add esp -> thiscall, ret 8). Without an entry: the error box (the original). For each club of the table (0x245 bytes; it stops at the first one that is a national team, `exe::database_is_national_team`: push; add esp, 4 -> cdecl) with a league (`club::DIVISION`) and an active (`.league_selected()`) nation (`club::NATION`) or a reputation (`club::REPUTATION`) of 5000, whose row (`exe::key_nation_index_of_club`: push; add esp, 4 -> cdecl) is the entry: the club's season end (`exe::financetable_season_end_club_update`: ecx = table; push club -> thiscall, ret 4) and the year's totals (`finance::SEASON_PLAYERS_BOUGHT`, 0x50 bytes) move into the previous year's (`finance::LAST_SEASON_TOTALS`) and are cleared, in the record whose index equals the club's.

The club's financial season end: ground purchase (20 million, from an owner in crisis), the squeeze, the AI club training facilities by random draw, undersoil heating (1.5 million) and roof (7.5 million), expansion or seating by balance and average attendance, the human's board requests (stadium and training) and the dividend by reputation, balance and chairman, with a random draw. 
 `FinanceTable::season_end_club_update(club)`, called from the nation's season end (`fin_prm_end_season_for_nation`). National team: nothing; no club: the error box (the original). The finances through the partner (`finance_of_parent_club`, `exe::club_get_linked_b_team`) and the balance (the low word, i32). With a stadium (`.stadium()`): 
 - not the owner (`.own_stadium()` = 0), with a league (`.division()`) and a balance above 35 million: buys the stadium for 20 million (`finance::MONTH_GROUND_COSTS`, `finance::SEASON_GROUND_COSTS`, balance; `.set_own_stadium(1)`; news 4, `post_works_news`), alone or from the owner (another club with the same stadium and `.own_stadium()`), if its finances are in crisis (`.crisis_state()` = 1 or 2): the owner stops being one (`.set_own_stadium(0)`) and receives the 20 million (`.month_other_income()`, `.season_other_income()`, balance; news 5); 
 - owner and with a league: the squeeze (`.squeeze_counter()` above 10, balance above 750 thousand) charges 10 − squeeze × 10000; the training facilities (`.training()` below 20) of an AI club with a manager (`upgrade_ai_training_ground`: `.manager()`, its `.non_player()` with `.youngsters()`) go up by random(40), charged to the club's own finances (level × 50000 + 75000, then up to 20 or one more level by reputation and balance); the human's stadium request (bit 6 of +2 of the manager row, `board_requests_row`) becomes the notice; the undersoil heating (stadium `.under_soil_heating()`, 1.5 million, news 6) and the roof (`.covered()`, 7.5 million); the expansion (by balance × 0.2, or × 0.1 when `.professional_status()` = `professional_status::PROFESSIONAL`, up to the ceiling `.expansion_capacity()` and a third of it; news 1 and 2) when the average attendance (`exe::comp_stats_find_club_entry` from the league table: ecx = `[comp + 8]`; push club; no add esp -> thiscall) exceeds 0.92 of the capacity (`.capacity()`), by reputation or by the notice; otherwise the seating (`.seating_capacity()`) by random(20) and the league size (`.division().reputation()`), by balance × 0.2 / 75 (news 3); the ceiling goes up by 1500 below 30 thousand places; the refusal (`post_works_refused_news`) to the human who asked. 
 Then, the human's training facilities request (bit 7): above (500 − reputation) × 500, the upgrade (`exe::financetable_upgrade_training_facilities`: ecx = table; push club -> thiscall, ret 4; news 8), otherwise the refusal; and the dividend (`pay_dividend`: `.month_dividends()`, `.season_dividends()`, balance; news `exe::finance_post_dividend_news`: ecx = table; 2 pushes -> thiscall, ret 8) by reputation, balance and chairman (`.chairman()`), with random(501) in the two larger branches.

Sends news 0x177c with the club id, the amount and the `.plc()` flag to the club's manager. \n SEH frame only for the local news item, no destructor on the normal path. `FinanceTable::news_dividend(club, value)`, called from the club's season end (`season_end_club_update`). News 0x177c (`exe::new_newsitem`: ecx = local; 2 pushes -> thiscall, ret 8) with the club id, the amount and the `.plc()` flag (`exe::newsitem_set_slot`: ecx = local; 2 pushes -> thiscall, ret 8), delivered to the club's manager (`exe::news_send_to_club_manager`: ecx = `[G_NEWS]`; 2 pushes -> thiscall, ret 8).

Computes the highest wage the club can offer: by reputation, wealth band and nation table; with a person, by the current contract, reputation squared, the roles, the human ceiling, the market, the contract near its end and the chairman; without a person, by the wage table less the payroll and budget per week, with the floor, the league and the nation; adjustments for clubs with `.professional_status()` 1 and 2, the league minimum + 100 and the lower of both ceilings. \n The asserts cite finance.CPP; 0x14ac bytes with x87. `person.get_max_wage(job_arg)`, called from the contract and transfer offers, the screens and the wage bill (`update_wage_bill`, without a person and with role −1). Club with `.professional_status()` = `professional_status::AMATEUR`: 0. The wage factor by reputation (/ 50, plus the wealth band `wealth_band` and the nation's wage table: 0x9c8498 small nations, 0x9c8548 medium, 0x9c85f8 France and clubs with `.plc()`, 0x9c86a8 the others) × 47.6 (ceiling 10000). With a person: the value of the contract at the club (`contract_wage`, up to 2 × the finances' ceiling `.wage_ceiling()`, at least that; a player limited by type `.job_for_club()`), the bonus for the one who pays more (`big_spender_bonus`), reputation² × 0.25 × 0.0001 + the floor `.highest_wage()`, the rules for roles 1 to 3, the human's ceiling (`human_manager_wage_cap`), the nation (Basque club `exe::database_is_basque_club`, the market from the transfer manager's table `[G_TRANSFER_MANAGER]` → `shortlist_manager_fields::CLUB_SHORTLISTS`, the contract near its end `exe::date_days_since`), the chairman (`.chairman()`: the liking `exe::staff_is_favoured_by` and the favourite `exe::club_favours_staff`, the profile `.business()`, the manager `.manager()`) and roles 1 to 6. Without a person: the nation factor (`.league_standard()` / 20 × the type `.state_of_development()`, for type 1 nations), the league (`.division()` and `.last_division()`, the size `.reputation()` cubed), the table by (factor / 10) minus (`.wage_bill()` − (factor³ × nation / divisor + balance × 1.3) / 52), with the floor 0x9c83e8 or 0x9c8338, the band and the nation. Then the club with `.professional_status()` 1 and 2, the league minimum + 100 and the lower of the two.

Sends news 0x177d with the club id, the amount and the works type to the club's manager. \n SEH frame only for the local news item, no destructor on the normal path. `FinanceTable::news_ground_works(club, value, kind)`, called from the club's season end (`season_end_club_update`: stadium purchase, heating, expansion and seating, training facilities) and from the week's events (`process_club_finance_events`). News 0x177d (`exe::new_newsitem`: lea ecx, local; push 0; push 0x177d -> thiscall, ret 8) with the club id, the amount and the kind (signed byte; `exe::newsitem_set_slot`: lea ecx, local; 2 pushes -> thiscall, ret 8), delivered to the club's manager (`exe::news_send_to_club_manager`: ecx = `[G_NEWS]`; push club; push &local -> thiscall, ret 8).

Sends news 0x1788 with the subject and the reason (2, or a random draw of 2) to the club's manager; no club, nothing. \n SEH frame only for the local news item, no destructor on the normal path. `FinanceTable::news_request_refused(club, subject, reason)`, called from the club's season end (`season_end_club_update`: the stadium or training facilities request refused). No club, nothing. News 0x1788 (`exe::new_newsitem`) with the subject (signed word) in data slot 1 and, in data slot 2, reason 2 or random(2) (`exe::utils_random`: push 2; add esp, 4 -> cdecl; the signed word), delivered to the club's manager (`exe::news_send_to_club_manager`).

writes the finances of every club into the finance.dat item (0x167 bytes × [`G_CLUB_COUNT`] (`club_count()`) from [this]); no container, nothing; on error the "Error" box (finance.CPP 0x115e, 0x1166) without closing the item

Reads the finances of every club from the finance.dat item into `[this]` and returns 1; no container, 0; on error the "Error" box (0x1137, 0x113f) and 0 (the constructor then rebuilds the finances from scratch). \n `FinanceTable::load_from_save(save)`: reads from the `finance.dat` item (`exe::zopen`, reading) the finances of all clubs, 0x167 bytes × `[G_CLUB_COUNT]` (`club_count()`), into `[this]`, and returns 1. No container: 0 with no box; error on open or short read: the "Error" box (finance.CPP 0x1137, 0x113f), 0, and the item stays open (as the original). With 0, the constructor (0x59a55c) rebuilds each club's finances from scratch (0x5961d0).

Processes a match's money: the TV money by attendance (1.75 × attendance), the gate receipts (`.gate_receipts()` of the result), the match costs and the home club's expenses (with random draws), the competition TV money by stage or type, divided by the nation type; in the home club's league, TV 3/4 and 1/4, the net to the home club and the stadium upkeep; outside it, half of each to both. \n `FinanceTable::process_match_income(fixture, result)`, called from the closing of the day's match (`close_day_match`). No result or no fixture: the error box (the original). A national team on either side: nothing (`match_club_finance`). The amounts: with attendance (`.attendance()` of the result), the TV by attendance (1 / (random(10) + 2) as an integer, which is 0, plus 1.75, × attendance) and the gate receipts (`.gate_receipts()`); the match costs (unless both clubs have `.professional_status()` = `professional_status::PROFESSIONAL`: attendance / 4; otherwise by bands of attendance or of the capacity `stadium::CAPACITY` of the fixture's stadium `.stadium()`, with a floor of 500 by flag `.home_side_mark()`); the home club's expenses (with `.professional_status()` = `professional_status::PROFESSIONAL`: random + attendance × 1.25 + reputation / 2 + 300, × 1.25 above 4750, or random(400) + attendance × 1.25 + 600 without reputation; otherwise two random draws + attendance); the competition TV money by stage (`.stage()`) or type (`.category()`: finals by the reputations, 6 and 4 by the competition's `.reputation()`); all divided by the nation type (`.state_of_development()`: 2 and 3) and once more in Wales and the Irelands. In the home club's league (`.division()` = `.competition()`, not at a neutral ground `.neutral_venue()`): TV 3/4 to the home club and 1/4 to the away club (+0x158, +0xb8, balance), the net to the home club (+0x140, +0xa0, balance) and, with its own stadium (`.own_stadium()`, `.stadium()`), the upkeep ((random(15) + 1) × 0.01 + 0.85) × the stadium's `stadium::CAPACITY` (`finance::SEASON_GROUND_COSTS`, `finance::MONTH_GROUND_COSTS`, subtracted from the balance). Outside it: half of each to both.

Computes the gate receipts: the price by the home club's reputation (/ 500; × 0.5 in friendlies, + 3 or + 4 in competitions) × attendance, less the finance discount in the home club's league; at a neutral ground, by the competition's `.reputation()`; adjusted by nation type, league, key clubs and the nation `KEY_NATION_GERMANY`. \n `FinanceTable::calc_gate_receipts(fixture, attendance)`, called from the fixture record (`fill_match_record`, the result's +0x38, which `process_match_income` adds to the home club's net). No fixture: the error box (the original); no attendance: 0; national team at home: 0. At a neutral ground (`.neutral_venue()`) of competition `.competition()`: (its `.reputation()` + 8) × attendance. Otherwise the price by the home club's reputation (`.reputation()` / 500): without a competition or in a friendly (`exe::friendly_is_friendly_competition`: push comp; ecx = `[G_FRIENDLY]`; no add esp -> thiscall, ret 4), × 0.5 × attendance; otherwise + 4 (one of the clubs with `.professional_status()` = `professional_status::PROFESSIONAL`) or + 3, × attendance; in the home club's league (`.division()`), minus the discount (the finances' float `finance::SEASON_TICKET_RATIO`) × the amount. Then by the nation type (`.state_of_development()`: 2 → /4; 3 → /10), × 1.25 in the league of `KEY_CLUB_COMP_ITALIAN_SERIE_A` or by the clubs of `G_KEY_CLUB_CHELSEA` (1.5), `G_KEY_CLUB_ARSENAL` and `G_KEY_CLUB_TOTTENHAM_HOTSPUR` (1.3), `G_KEY_CLUB_EVERTON` (0.75) and `G_KEY_CLUB_LIVERPOOL` (0.9), and × 1.2 in the nation of `KEY_NATION_GERMANY`.
adds the fine to the season (`.season_fines()`) and month (`.month_fines()`) fines and takes it from the balance

Tries a cash boost for the club: outside seven nations and `.professional_status()` 2 and 3, the divisor by wealth band and reputation; with the chairman record, three random draws (against `player_sheet::GOALKEEPER`, the debt and 750 × `non_player::RESOURCES`) give (3 × (`non_player::RESOURCES`)² + 750) × reputation + 1 million plus the balance; without it, two draws give (reputation + 1000) × 1000; a third in three nations; then the money, the news by type and the end of the crisis. \n `FinanceTable::try_finance_boost_event(club, fin)`, called from the week's events pass (`process_club_finance_events`). Outside Wales, the Irelands and the nations of `KEY_NATION_NORWAY`, `KEY_NATION_DENMARK`, `KEY_NATION_SWEDEN` and `KEY_NATION_BELGIUM`, and without `.professional_status()` at 2 or 3. The divisor by the band (`wealth_band`): rich 0.001; 0 by reputation (up to 4250: 0.0125 with the chairman's (`.chairman()`) `.ambition()` and the record's (`.non_player()`) `player_sheet::BRAVERY` above 15, otherwise 0.0075; up to 6250: 0.05 or 0.025 the same way; above: 0.025); −1: 0.1 above 5250, 0.075 above 3250, 0.025; −2: 0.125 above 3750, 0.075. With the chairman's record: random(its `player_sheet::GOALKEEPER`) above random(30 / divisor), random(`non_player::RESOURCES` × 1 million) above the debt and reputation below 750 × `non_player::RESOURCES`: (3 × (`non_player::RESOURCES`)² + 750) × reputation + 1 million, plus the low balance (less if the balance is negative), with the ceiling of reputation² + 1.5 million below 2000. Without it: random(15000 / divisor) below the reputation and random(8) zero: (reputation + 1000) × 1000. A third in the nations of `is_scandinavian_club` (`KEY_NATION_SWEDEN`, `KEY_NATION_NORWAY` and `KEY_NATION_DENMARK`). Into `.season_other_income()`, `.month_other_income()` and the balance (`credit_income`); the news (`post_finance_boost_news`, `exe::finance_post_finance_boost_news`) by type (by the budget `transfer_budget`, the flag `.plc()` and random draws of 4: 3, 5, 6, 7 with `.set_plc(1)`, or 1); with the record, its `.resources()` drops by 1 above 5; ends the crisis (`.set_crisis_state(0)`); returns 1.

Tries a board takeover of an indebted club: the divisor by band and the factor by reputation and league; random draws by the chairman record and by 15000 / divisor; (reputation + 1000) × 1000 less the balance (or just what clears the balance); with the record, the new chairman (drawn nation, names and record); the news (type 2) and the end of the crisis. \n `FinanceTable::try_board_takeover(club, fin)`, called from the week's events pass (`process_club_finance_events`, clubs in debt). The divisor by the band (`wealth_band`: −2: 0.4 above reputation 4250, otherwise 0.25; −1: 0.2 or 0.05; others: 0.001) and the factor (reputation × 0.002 / the `.reputation()` of league `.division()`, at least 0.75; without a league 0.5). With the chairman's (`.chairman()`) record (`staff::NON_PLAYER`): random(its `.wing_back()`) zero; without it: random(20) zero. Then random(15000 / divisor) below reputation × factor: (reputation + 1000) × 1000 minus the low balance; above 40 million, with the reputation below random(2500) + 2000, only what clears the balance. Into `.month_other_income()`, `.season_other_income()` and the balance; with the record, the new chairman: the nation (`staff::NATION`: the club's if random(1000) ≠ 0, otherwise a drawn one), the names (`exe::database_pick_first_name_for_nation`, `exe::database_get_empty_common_name`, `exe::database_pick_second_name_for_nation`) and the record (+0x1d, +0xf, +0x16, +0x20 = random(20) + 1; `non_player::RESOURCES` drawn again if it came out below 5); the news (`post_finance_boost_news`, `exe::finance_post_finance_boost_news`, type 2, with the budget `transfer_budget`); ends the crisis (`.set_crisis_state(0)`); returns 1.
adds the amount to the season (`.season_other_costs()`) and month (`.month_other_costs()`) other costs and takes it from the balance

Recomputes the wage bill: sums the squad wages (less the other club's share for loanees) and the staff wages into the wage bill (+0xc) and the highest wage (`finance::HIGHEST_WAGE`); with fewer than 15 players, the missing places at a wage by reputation; plus reputation² × a factor by club type and nation; the wage ceiling (`finance::WAGE_CEILING`) by `get_max_wage`. \n `Finance::update_wage_bill()`, called from the daily finance pass (0x59b9c0, on Saturdays, clubs with a nation), contract signing (`sign_contract`), the daily contracts pass (0x4c7ac0), loans (`sign_loan_contract`, `end_loan`) and the wage bills at creation (`refresh_all_wage_bills`). Clears the highest wage (`finance::HIGHEST_WAGE`) and the bill (+0xc) and sums the wages (the contract's `contract::WAGE`) of the 50 squad slots (`.squad(k)`; contract with the club `exe::contract_manager_get_contract_for_club`; wage −1: the default wage `exe::staff_contract_default_staff_contract` truncated; on loan (`exe::contract_manager_get_loan_contract`) outside type 6 (`contract::CONTRACT_TYPE`): minus the other contract's wage) and of the staff (+0x19f × 5, +0x1b3 × 7, +0x1cf × 3, contract `exe::contract_manager_get_contract`). Squad with fewer than 15 slots filled: the missing ones at a wage by reputation (`.reputation()`: above 4750, rep − 1950; above 2250, (rep − 2250) × 0.5 + 550; otherwise rep × 0.25; outside type 1 (`.professional_status()` = `professional_status::PROFESSIONAL`), × 0.5; divided by the nation type (`nation::STATE_OF_DEVELOPMENT`, between 1 and 3)). Plus reputation² × k (type 1: England and Italy 0.001 / 0.0008 / 0.0006 above 5250 / 3250; others 0.0004; outside type 1: 0.0002 above 3250, otherwise 0.0001), truncated. The wage ceiling (`finance::WAGE_CEILING`) is redone by Finance::get_max_wage (`FN_FINANCE_GET_MAX_WAGE`, 0, −1).

Returns the days until the season start of the club's nation, inside the season ticket window (up to two months before); flags whether the season year has come. \n `finance_get_days_to_season_start(club, &passed)`, called from the daily finance pass (0x59b9c0; ecx holds the table, which it does not read): days until the start of the season of the club's nation (72-byte row at 0xb63d60 via `exe::key_nation_index_of_club`; without a row, the "Error" box at line 0x1185 and 0). `passed` = 1 if today's year (`G_CURRENT_DATE_YEAR`) reaches the season year (2002 with `key_nation_record::SPLIT_SEASON_FLAG`, otherwise the year of the game start `G_GAME_START_DATE_YEAR` + 1). Start month (`key_nation_record::START_MONTH`) below 2: in the start year (`key_nation_record::START_DATE_YEAR`), only after month 12 − start month; in another year, only before the start month; otherwise, only 0..2 months before the start. Inside the window, the days until the start date (`key_nation_record::START_DATE`, `exe::date_days_since`) if positive; outside, 0.

Adds the amount (64 bits) to the sales of the month (`.month_players_sold()`) and of the year (`.season_players_sold()`) and to the balance. \n `amount.add_players_sold()` (64-bit amount), called from the transfer payment (TRANSFER_MANAGER::pay_fee_and_record_clauses `pay_fee_and_record_clauses` and the instalments 0x8caf.., 0x8cb3..) and from the previous clubs' share (`pay_former_club_fee_cuts`): adds the amount to the sales of the month (`.month_players_sold()`) and of the year (`.season_players_sold()`), in 64 bits, and to the balance (i64 at +0, `fin_prm_add_i64`).

Adds the amount (64 bits) to the purchases of the month (`.month_players_bought()`) and of the year (`.season_players_bought()`) and takes it from the balance. \n `amount.pay_players_bought()` (64-bit amount), called from the transfer payment (`pay_fee_and_record_clauses`) and the instalments (0x8caf.., 0x8cb3..): adds the amount to the purchases of the month (`.month_players_bought()`) and of the year (`.season_players_bought()`), in 64 bits, and subtracts it from the balance.

Adds the amount to the signing-on fees of the month (`.month_sign_on_fees()`) and of the year (`.season_sign_on_fees()`) and takes it from the balance. \n `amount.pay_sign_on_fee()`, called from an accepted contract offer (`complete_accepted_contract_offer`) and from the player's change of club (`exe::transfer_manager_move_player_to_club`): adds the amount to the signing-on fees of the year (`.season_sign_on_fees()`) and of the month (`.month_sign_on_fees()`) and subtracts it from the balance (sign-extended).

Adds the amount to the prize money of the month (`.month_prize_money()`) and of the year (`.season_prize_money()`) and to the balance. \n `amount.add_prize_money()`, called from the cups (Cup::process_fixture `exe::cup_process_fixture`, EuropeanCup::process_fixture `process_fixture`, the stage draws), the end of the leagues (League::pay_prize_money `pay_prize_money`) and the season honours: adds the amount to the prize money of the year (`.season_prize_money()`) and of the month (`.month_prize_money()`) and to the balance.

Adds the amount to the TV income of the month (`.month_tv_revenue()`) and of the year (`.season_tv_revenue()`) and to the balance. \n `amount.add_tv_revenue()`, called only from the league TV rights (League::pay_tv_rights `pay_tv_rights`, when each league's table is built for the new season): adds the amount to the TV income of the year (`.season_tv_revenue()`) and of the month (`.month_tv_revenue()`) and to the balance.
adds the amount to the wages of the month (`.month_wages()`) and of the year (`.season_wages()`) and takes it from the balance (the free release compensation)

Adds the weekly merchandising income: attendance × reputation × factor (by the stadium of the `.chairman()` club or by reputation; Japan one step up), × (random(11) + 95)%, added to `finance::MONTH_MERCHANDISING`, `finance::SEASON_MERCHANDISING` and the balance. \n `FinanceTable::add_weekly_merchandising_income(club)`, called from the daily finance pass (0x59b9c0, on day 6 of the week, league clubs). The base: with the `.chairman()` club and its stadium (`.non_player()`), the level (`.business()`) × 25 + the reputation (`.reputation()`), × 0.65 truncated if byte `.own_stadium()` is zero, picks the factor by 5500 and 4000; without them, the reputation picks it by 5250 and 3750 (one step higher in the nation of Japan `KEY_NATION_JAPAN`). Attendance (`.attendance()`) × reputation × factor, truncated; × (random(11) + 95) × 0.01, truncated, added to `finance::MONTH_MERCHANDISING`, `finance::SEASON_MERCHANDISING` and the balance.

Sells season tickets: stadium of at least 1500 places; demand by the manager-table value, attendance and reputation, up to 87.5% of the places; new holders by the step fraction (`.season_ticket_step()`) and a random draw; ratio at `finance::SEASON_TICKET_RATIO`; income (with apply) by price, nation type and key clubs; the shop with two random draws by reputation. \n `apply.sell_season_tickets()`, called from the daily finance pass (0x59b9c0, on day 6 of the week, when finance_get_days_to_season_start `finance_get_days_to_season_start` says the season is still to start). The club by id (`.club_id()`, 0x245-byte record); a stadium (`.stadium()`) with fewer than 1500 places (`stadium::CAPACITY`) uses reputation × 2.5 (minimum 1500). The demand: the club's value in the managers' manager (`[[G_MANAGER_MANAGER]]` + 73·id + 8) × 0.0001 (minimum 0.15) × attendance (`.attendance()`), × reputation × 0.00025 (minimum 0.5), capped at 87.5% of the places (1250 without a stadium). Above those already sold (`.season_tickets_sold()`): the step (`.season_ticket_step()`, up to 8) picks the fraction (0x9c8758) of the difference, × (random(11) + 95) / 100 = the new ones; the sold/places ratio goes to `.season_ticket_ratio()` (f32, up to 0.875). The income (price by reputation × new ones; /4 or /10 by the nation type `.state_of_development()`; × 1.25 in Serie A, Chelsea 1.5, Arsenal and Tottenham 1.3, Everton 0.75, Liverpool 0.9, Germany 1.2) is applied only with `apply`; then (random(rep) + random(rep) + 1) × 0.001 + 1, × new ones, into `.season_merchandising()`.

Raises the training facilities level (`club::TRAINING`) by reputation (up to 20); each step charges the works to `finance::MONTH_GROUND_COSTS`, `finance::SEASON_GROUND_COSTS` and the balance (`charge_works_cost`). \n `FinanceTable::upgrade_training_facilities(club)`, called from the club's season end (`season_end_club_update`, with the training request approved by the board). The level (`club::TRAINING`) goes up by 2 (1 from 19) and charges level × 50000 + 75000. Then, below 20: with reputation (`.reputation()`) above 8250, it goes to 20 and charges (22 − level) × 250000 (minimum 2 million); below 14 with reputation above 5250, it goes up by 4 (minimum 16) and charges 3.5 million − level × 150000 (minimum 1 million); below 16 with reputation above 4250, or below 20 with reputation above 7250: above 7250 it goes to 20, otherwise up by 2 (minimum 12), and charges the new level × 50000 + 75000. Ceiling 20.

Processes the club's finance events by the finance band: ends or opens the crisis (`finance::CRISIS_STATE`), moves the squeeze counter (`finance::SQUEEZE_COUNTER`), tries the boost, the debt, the injection and the board takeover, wears the training ground; with squeeze above 50, removes the heating or closes 10% of the places. \n `FinanceTable::process_club_finance_events(club, week)`, called from the daily finance pass (0x59b9c0: at the turn of the week with week = 1 for every league club with reputation 5000 or an active nation; on other days only for the club in crisis, with week = random zero). The club's finances (from partner A, `exe::club_get_linked_b_team`) and the band (`wealth_band`): 2 and 1 (rich) and 0 end the crisis (`finance::CRISIS_STATE`, `leave_crisis`) and lower the squeeze counter (`finance::SQUEEZE_COUNTER`) to 5/0/10; 1 and 0 try the boost (`try_finance_boost_event`), the debt (`try_board_debt_payment`) and the injection (`try_cash_injection`); −1 sets state 2, raises the squeeze by byte `.own_stadium()`, wears the training facilities (`decay_training_ground`) and tries the debt, the injection and the board takeover (`try_board_takeover`); −2 enters the crisis (news `exe::finance_post_financial_crisis_news`, clears flag `.plc()`, and at the human club `exe::human_manager_is_human_club` lowers the value of the squad contracts through `exe::contract_manager_calc_player_value`, setting bit 4 of `.transfer_status()`) or, already in crisis, tries the takeover, the injection and the boost, wears the facilities and raises the squeeze by 3. Then, with an active league (`[G_COMP_OBJECT_TABLE]`) and squeeze above 50: removes the heating (`stadium::UNDER_SOIL_HEATING`, `FN_FINANCE_POST_STADIUM_WORKS_NEWS`) of a club with reputation below 4250, or closes 10% of the places (`stadium::CAPACITY` to `stadium::EXPANSION_CAPACITY`, `exe::finance_post_stand_closed_news`, squeeze 20); the training facilities drop by random draw.

Tries a board payment of a poor club's debt (band −2/−1, or 0 with a low balance): after three random draws, the board pays 450, 300 or 150 × reputation and sends the news. \n `FinanceTable::try_board_debt_payment(club, fin)`, called from the events pass (`process_club_finance_events`). Band (`wealth_band`) −2, −1 (divisor 2, or 0.4 with reputation of 3500), or 0 with reputation up to 3500 and a balance below 25 × reputation (0.4); the others: 0. random(7000) + 3500 above the reputation; random(6 / divisor) zero; random(level `.resources()` of the stadium `.non_player()` of the `.chairman()` club, or 10) not zero. The board pays 450 × reputation (below 1250 with a balance below −450 × reputation), 300 × (balance below −300 × reputation) or 150 ×: into `.season_other_income()`, `.month_other_income()` and the balance; the news (`post_finance_boost_news`, `exe::finance_post_finance_boost_news`, type 4); returns 1.

Tries a cash injection for a club of reputation 4750 outside Wales and the Irelands: random draws by the band and the stadium of the `.chairman()` club; the amount by reputation, up to 10% of the debt and 4 million; news and end of the crisis. \n `FinanceTable::try_cash_injection(club, fin)`, called from the events pass (`process_club_finance_events`). Reputation (`.reputation()`) of 4750, without flag `.plc()`, outside Wales and the Irelands. Divisor by the band (`wealth_band`; −2: 0.25; −1: 0.1; others: 0.001). With the stadium (`.non_player()`) of the `.chairman()` club: random(30 / divisor) below the level (`.business()`) and level `.resources()` above random(5) + 10: (20 × level + 150) × reputation + 750000; without it: random(4 / divisor) zero: (5 × reputation + 15000) × 50. Debt above 10 × the amount: 10% of the debt. Ceiling: reputation² + 1.5 million below 2000; otherwise 4 million (+1 if the amount exceeds reputation² / 4). Into `.season_other_income()`, `.month_other_income()` and the balance; the news (`post_finance_boost_news`, `exe::finance_post_finance_boost_news`, type 3, with the budget `transfer_budget`); ends the crisis (`.set_crisis_state(0)`); returns 1.

Returns the highest weekly wage the club offers a staff member for a job: default by job, nation level (`.league_standard()`) / type, key nation adjustments, league weight × 0.2, finance band, club ceiling (`.wage_ceiling()`) and job range. \n `job.get_max_staff_wage()`, used by renewal (`contract_manager_offer_contract`), interest in the job (`exe::staff_interest_in_job_at_club`) and the contract screens. Club by id (`.club_id()`); type 3 (`.professional_status()` = `professional_status::AMATEUR`): 0. The default by job (5 to 7: 35000; 8: 20000; 9: 1500; 10: 1000; others: 750); national team (`exe::database_is_national_team`): the default. Without a nation (`.nation()`): default × 0.25. With a nation: the level (`.league_standard()`) / (20 × type `.state_of_development()` between 1 and 3) × default; in type 1, England, Italy and Spain × 1.05 with reputation above 7250, Japan nothing, USA above 1750 with 0.75 of the excess, and the other groups with the excess above 2500/1250/750 by the factor (0.75/0.75/0.3, or reputation/50 / level × 0.1 × it, up to 1); with a league (`.division()`), × the league weight (`.reputation()`) × 0.2. By the finance band (`exe::finance_get_wealth_band`): −2 × 0.75, −1 × 0.95, 1 × 1.5, 2 × 2. Limited to the club's ceiling (`.wage_ceiling()`) and to the job's range.
wage ceiling (`.wage_ceiling()`) × (percentage + 100)%, truncated

Returns the club's wealth band: national team, 0; by the 64-bit balance against the club reputation R: above 2500·R + 5,000,000, 2; above 1000·R + 3,500,000, 1; below −2,500,000 − 1500·R, −2; below −250·R (R < 5000) or (3750 − R)·1000, −1; otherwise 0. \n `Finance::get_wealth_band()`, the band of the club's (`.club_id()`, array 0xae23b4, `club_at`) balance (64 bits at +0/+4) by the reputation R (`.reputation()`), used by transfers, the board, the managers, the finances and the postponement. National team (`exe::database_is_national_team`): 0. Above 2500·R + 5,000,000: 2; above 1000·R + 3,500,000: 1; below −2,500,000 − 1500·R: −2; below −250·R (R < 5000) or (3750 − R)·1000 (R ≥ 5000): −1; otherwise 0.

Adjusts the board's confidence after the match: the rivalry, the reputation gap or the team and opponent ratings in the match, the score, the aggregate, the derby and rival, the competition weight; writes the four confidence values (1 to 10000, with floors by stage), raises the media stories and the fan protest, and decides whether to consider sacking the manager. \n `MANAGER_MANAGER::update_board_confidence_after_match(club, fixture, game, home)`, called from the board after the match (`update_board_after_fixture`, one side at a time). The adjustment starts from the rivalry (±20/30 against the opponent or by the fixture's national side `.stadium()`), adds the reputation difference / 35 (without a match) or, with the match, the team rating (average of the ratings by age +0x1c4, the ratings `.home_shots()`/`.home_shots_on_target()`, the difference with the opponent, the sum of +0x4d − rating; x87: (... + 0.1) × 67 − 470, × factor) plus the average reputation of the opponents (by nation, `exe::database_is_staff_foreign`) against the club's / 40, up to ±100. By the score (`fixture::HOME_GOALS_EXTRA_TIME`/`fixture::AWAY_GOALS_EXTRA_TIME` or `fixture::HOME_GOALS`/`fixture::AWAY_GOALS`): win 0x800, defeat 0x1000 (outside friendlies, × 2 or × 5 with a thrashing; below −50 with an AI manager, the request to the FA `exe::manager_manager_handle_fa_request` by random draw), draw 0x400 (in the cup, +15 and the stages 0x7b/0x7c/0x85/0x86/0x99/0x9a). The aggregate (`.home_aggregate()`/`.away_aggregate()`, `.home_penalties()`/`.away_penalties()`, `.home_goals()`/`.away_goals()`) gives 0x100/0x200 and ±10/15/20; the derby (0x40, same city or a rival within 25 km) or the rival/clash (0x80) multiply the weight (2.25 or 1.5) and give ±12/±5. Weight × 0.5 for the B national team, × 2 for the senior one, × 2 or 1.5 in the cup (flag `expectation_flags_byte1::EUROPEAN_SUCCESS` (0x400) of the row's `board_record::EXPECTATION_FLAGS`); the adjustment × weight, ÷ 3 or ÷ 2 by the flags. The flags 1/2/4/8/0x10/0x20 (by the score, the adjustment and confidence `board_record::CONFIDENCE`) go into the text (`FN_MANAGER_MANAGER_BUILD_BOARD_MATCH_REACTION_TEXT`) and into the reaction news (`exe::manager_manager_post_board_match_reaction_news`, human manager only). The media story 0x3d (`exe::media_post_team_media_story`, −250 at `board_record::FAVOURITES_MOOD`) by random draw at a manageable club; story 0x5c in the league with the club in danger. The confidence: `board_record::CONFIDENCE` += 0.7 ×, `board_record::STAFF_CONFIDENCE` += 0.5 ×, `board_record::SUPPORTERS_CONFIDENCE` += 1.15 ×, `board_record::CONFIDENCE_4` += 0.2 × (half with flag `exe::player_regen_get_retirement_status` when negative), between 1 and 10000; floors by stage and by the competition's strength; the fan protest (`exe::manager_manager_post_supporter_protest_news`); in the league or when negative, consider sacking (`exe::manager_manager_consider_sacking_manager`, 1 on a defeat); otherwise it leaves the ultimatum list (`manager_manager_fields::ULTIMATUM_LIST`, `exe::llist_remove`).

Posts news item 0x138c with the board's reaction to the match for the club's manager: the flags, the clubs, the scores, the named players and the match record. \n SEH frame with no destructor on the normal path. `MANAGER_MANAGER::post_board_match_reaction_news(club, other, fixture, marks, a, b, c, d)`: with club, opponent, fixture and competition (`.competition()`), news 0x138c (`exe::new_newsitem`) with the flags, the two ids, the scores a and b, the aggregate c and d and the fixture's `.match_stats_slot()`; the up to 3 players the board names (`FN_MANAGER_MANAGER_COLLECT_BOARD_MATCH_REACTION_PLAYERS`, with defeat = a > b), a random(4), the defeat and their 5 flags; the club's match record (`exe::fill_match_record_from_fixture`) written into the news (`exe::write_match_record_to_news`); delivered to the club's manager (`exe::news_send_to_club_manager`).

Posts news item 0x1781 with the FA's assessment of the national team manager in a competition, from the game start. \n SEH frame with no destructor on the normal path. `MANAGER_MANAGER::post_fa_performance_news(comp, national_team, rating)`: from the game start date (`G_GAME_START_DATE`) on, news 0x1781 (`exe::new_newsitem`) with the national team's id, the competition's id (*comp) and the FA's rating, through the reach (`exe::news_send_by_scope` with the national team and 0, 0, 0, 0).

Sets the board's season expectations: the target in the league (danger position, wealth, previous division, manager tenure) and the expectation flags (title, European places, top half, avoid relegation), the chairman draws, the departure by tenure, the confidence values pulled back to 6500 and the manager record; a national team takes those of its competition. \n `MANAGER_MANAGER::set_season_expectations(club, news)`. Clears the flags (`board_record::EXPECTATION_FLAGS`) and the target (`board_record::TARGET_POSITION`), `board_record::SPENDING` = reputation² / 4, `board_record::SQUAD_INVESTMENT` ÷ 4, +0 = 0. Without flag `board_record_flags::NEW_MANAGER` of `board_record::FLAGS`, with a manager and outside national teams: by the manager's days in the job (`exe::date_days_since`), above 3650 with confidence `board_record::CONFIDENCE` < 3500 (random(30) above the chairman's `non_player::PATIENCE`, or 10) or above 1825 with `board_record::CONFIDENCE` < 3000 (random(20)), the item {1, 6, id} in list `manager_manager_fields::DEPARTURE_LIST` (`exe::llist_add_tail`). National team: the B team nothing; the senior one takes its competition's expectations (`exe::nationalteams_get_current_competition` and `comp_vtable::GET_QUALIFICATION_STATUS`) and the FA news (`exe::manager_manager_post_fa_expectations_news`). Club: the nation's UEFA places (`exe::uefaseeding_get_nation_places` on `[G_UEFA_SEEDING]`); without a manager nothing; without a division with a competition: `expectation_flags::AVOID_RELEGATION`. The target = the danger position of the league row (`.final_position()`; without it, 8 with `expectation_flags::RESPECTABLE_POSITION` and the news, and it returns), minus 1 if it is the last one; by wealth (`exe::finance_get_wealth_band`: 2 → −3/−2, 1 → −2/−1, 0 with budget (`exe::finance_get_transfer_budget`) above 250 × reputation → −1, −1 → +1 below 5, −2 → +1); by the previous division (`.last_division()`: stronger +4/+2, weaker −7/−3/−2) or by the manager's days (below 365 +1; above 1095 −1 above 10); between 1 and the number of clubs − 1; with flag `board_record_flags::NEW_MANAGER`, the average with the row's `.current_position()` between `.best_position()` and `.worst_position()`. The flags: `expectation_flags::TITLE_CHALLENGE` (champion's place), `expectation_flags::EUROPEAN_QUALIFICATION` (UEFA places, outside Australia), `expectation_flags::PROMOTION` (`league::PROMOTED_COUNT`), `expectation_flags::PLAYOFFS` (`league::PROMOTION_PLAYOFF_COUNT`), `expectation_flags::RESPECTABLE_POSITION` (top half), `expectation_flags::RELEGATION_BATTLE` (avoid relegation, `league::RELEGATED_COUNT`) or `expectation_flags::AVOID_RELEGATION`/0; chairman draws (0x80, 0x100 `expectation_flags_byte1::CUP_SUCCESS`, 0x200 by the target) and the cup league (`[G_CLUB_COMP_TABLE]`, 0x400 `expectation_flags_byte1::EUROPEAN_SUCCESS` or the swap 0x80/0x200). The news (`exe::manager_manager_post_board_expectations_news`). Confidence values below 6500 rise to (5x + 27500 or 25000) / 10 (`finish_board_update`); the wealth into `board_record::WEALTH_BAND`; the manager's record (`non_player::CURRENT_REPUTATION`, `non_player::WORLD_REPUTATION`) rises to the club's reputation; the new manager (of the last 16) gets 1 in `staff::LOYALTY` up to 20; clears `board_record::FLAGS`, `board_record::REQUEST_STATE`, `board_record::REQUESTS_MADE`, `board_record::WAGE_RISE_GRANTED`, `board_record::LEAGUE_CONFIDENCE`..`board_record::FAVOURITES_MOOD`, `board_record::EXTRA_FUNDS_GRANTED` and `board_record::DISCIPLINE_COUNTERS` & 7; the fines (`exe::fine_halve_club_fine_count` on `[G_FINE]`).

Resets the club board and picks the manager for the vacancy: the best score among the free people who qualify (or the assistant, or the first free one counting backwards), sometimes a better drawn one; the announcement and arrival dates and the item in the vacancy list; the human managers apply. \n SEH frame with no destructor on the normal path. `MANAGER_MANAGER::add_job_vacancy(club, left)`. Club without a division and with reputation below 5000: nothing; B national team with ranking (nation's `.number_staff()`) up to 1000 or senior team up to 100: nothing. The board starts over (the four confidence values 5000, `board_record::EXPECTATION_FLAGS` = `expectation_flags::AVOID_RELEGATION`, the flags cleared). The chosen one: from all people with a manager record (`staff::NON_PLAYER`; the last 16, the humans, only with `staff::CLASSIFICATION`), except the one who left, without state 0x30 (`staff_state_byte_b`), without a contract (`loan_contract_of`), off the lists (`is_vacancy_candidate`), of the same nation or with `non_player::CURRENT_REPUTATION` ≥ 3750, of the same continent (`nation::REGION`) or with `non_player::WORLD_REPUTATION` ≥ 4250 and the club with reputation ≥ 4750, suited to the job (`is_staff_suitable` with 3.5), excluding players with a contract in force in jobs 11/12/13/15, only national team managers (`staff::JOB_FOR_CLUB` = 5) for a national team: the highest score (`score_candidate`, `exe::score_staff_for_job`). With nobody: the assistant (`.assistant_manager()`), the first of `.coaches(0)` or, from back to front starting at the 17th from last, the first free person in jobs 0, 5, 6, 7, 8, 11, 12, 15 (without wrapping around: the "Can't find a manager" box and nothing). National team or big club (reputation above 4500 + random(2000)): draws as many people as their count and keeps the best free one (with 150 days in the job, 3.15). The human rejected by the club (`exe::staff_add_disliked_club`). The dates: before the game start, 1 to 7 days after it (the announcement) and the arrival 1 to 7 days later; otherwise, the announcement in 1 to 3 days and the arrival in 4 to 8 days (7 to 11 if the one who left is human; 10 to 14 with the offer news `exe::manager_manager_post_job_offer_news` to the chosen one's human club), sometimes 0 to 19 more; the turn of the year. The item goes into list `manager_manager_fields::VACANCY_LIST` (`exe::llist_add_tail`, the cursor `llist::CURSOR` saved); the humans (`exe::human_manager_is_on_holiday`, `exe::human_manager_get_holiday_option`) of smaller clubs apply (`exe::manager_manager_apply_for_job`).

Posts news item 0x1775 telling the club's manager that another club offered one of his staff the manager job. \n SEH frame with no destructor on the normal path. `MANAGER_MANAGER::post_job_offer_news(person, club)`: with the person employed (`.club_job()`) and the club, from the game start (`G_GAME_START_DATE`) on, news 0x1775 (`exe::new_newsitem`) with the person's id, the three names (`names::ID` of `.first_name()`, `.second_name()`, `.common_name()`), the id of the club where they are, that of the offering club and the job (`.job_for_club()`), to the manager of their club (`exe::news_send_to_club_manager`).

After the match, by a random draw, gathers the league position for the news and the manager's favoured or rejected players who played badly, with the board confidence rising or falling because of them. \n Called from the board's news after the match (`post_board_match_reaction_news`): `(game, club, ids, fixture, elogio, a6..a10)`. Sets the 3 ids to −1. Club outside the national teams with a manager (`.chairman()`) with a record (`.non_player()`): random(the record's `.interference()`) against random(10); if it passes, it clears the 5 outputs and, in a match of the club's division, a10 = 1 and, from the league table (`exe::comp_stats_find_club_entry`, with more than 8 matches, `.matches_played()`), a9/a8 (the row's `.best_position()`/`.current_position()`), a7 (the board's `board_record::TARGET_POSITION`) and a6 (2 or 0xfe by the row's `.winning_run()`/`.losing_run()`). The players (job 11, with a record) that the manager rejects (`FN_STAFF_GET_DISLIKED_STAFF`, if `elogio` = 0) or favours (`FN_STAFF_GET_FAVOURED_STAFF`), of the club by contract (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract`, on `[G_CONTRACT_LOOKUP_RESULT]`), below the club's reputation (rejected) or up to 35 years old and above it − 750 (favoured), with a rating below 7 in the match (`exe::get_player_match_rating_verdict` = −1): their ids go into `ids` and the board confidence (`board_record::CONFIDENCE`) rises (favoured) or falls (rejected) by 10 × the manager's `.ambition()`. Returns the sum of the two counts (the caller does not read it).

Finds the player among the starters of the match record: −1 for a rating under 7, 1 above, otherwise 0. \n SEH frame for the local array. `get_player_match_rating_verdict(person, fixture)`: reads the match record (`exe::match_stats_read_match_record` on `[G_MATCH_STATS]`, with the two 0x625-byte sides constructed and destroyed by the iterators `exe::crt_vector_constructor_iterator`/`exe::crt_vector_destructor_iterator`) and looks for the person among the first 11 of each side (ids at `match_record::HOME_TEAM` + `match_record_team::ROWS`, `match_record_row::SIZE` bytes): a rating (`.match_grade()`) below 7 gives −1, above 7 gives 1, 7 gives 0; not found (or no person), 0. The ecx is irrelevant.

Builds the board sentence praising or blaming the named player, by variant. \n `build_board_player_performance_text(ids, win, out, variant)`, called from the board text (0x6a69c0). The original keeps only the first id that is not −1 (in its own place, 0, 1 or 2), counts 1, and the texts always read place 0. Win: with the first one, the name (`exe::database_format_staff_name`, 200, style 1) in one of the three praises by variant (0, 1, other); then, since no player counts on a defeat, the output stays empty (the original clears the first byte). Defeat: the output empty and, with the first one, one of the four blames by variant (0, 1, 2, other), with 100 and the name. Without ids, nothing.

Checks whether the board vetoes a transfer: when buying an injured player, the physios draw the veto; at a human club, the board vetoes on budget, asking price or fee and loses confidence. \n `MANAGER_MANAGER::check_board_transfer_veto(j, club, value, comprando)`, called from `check_board_veto` (offer without a swap). When buying a player with an injury (`exe::injury_get_player_injury`) of severity `.days_out()` > 20, each of the club's three physios (`.physios(k)`, with a record `.non_player()`) seeds the CRT rand with the two ids and draws: retirement announced because of the injury (`exe::player_regen_find_retirement_entry`) against his rating (`FN_NON_PLAYER_ATTRIBUTE_RATING` of byte `.physiotherapy()`), the severity against random(200) + 25 and (41 − rating) × 5, the relapse (`exe::injury_get_recurring_injury_level`), rating³ + 100 (pow `game_pow`) and the rating against the player's (`.player().injury_proneness()`): any of them vetoes (0x2000); at the end the rand goes back to the clock (`exe::at_946ebb`). Then, only with a contract outside types 1 and 3 (`contract::CONTRACT_TYPE`), a current club (`.club_job()`) and a human club (`exe::human_manager_is_human_club`): the limit (reputation `.reputation()` × 0.2)² between 150 thousand and 2 million. Selling: a league with a division and a squad below 15, the board loses 1250/1250/500 (+6/+0x14/+0x16, `add_board_confidence`, floor 1 on +6, `clamp_confidence_floor`) and vetoes 0x200; otherwise the asking price (`FN_CONTRACT_MANAGER_CALC_ASKING_PRICE`, at most the value for the contract's club) above the limit and the value for the current club not below `value`: asking > 2 × value with the contract's `contract::HAPPINESS` > 25, or asking > 5 million with `contract::HAPPINESS` > 0 and > 2.5 × value, lose 1250/1250/500; > 6 × value, 500/500/250; veto 0x800. Buying: an amount above 1.2 × the budget (`exe::finance_get_transfer_budget`) vetoes 0x800; above the limit, the lowest value (for the club and for the contract's club) + 0.65 × limit + the wealth band (`exe::finance_get_wealth_band`: 1.25 million, 650 thousand or 65 thousand), truncated, below 0.275 × value loses 250/500/500 and vetoes 0x800. Otherwise 0.

Posts the 0x178d news of the ultimatum before the match, to the club's manager or, by a random draw, to those of the division or the country. \n SEH frame for the local news item. `MANAGER_MANAGER::post_board_ultimatum_news(club, opponent, comp)`, called from the board ultimatum (`issue_board_ultimatum`). Club with a division (`.division()`), a manager (`.manager()`) and the competition: news 0x178d (`exe::new_newsitem`) with the manager (the id and the three keys, `names::ID` of `.first_name()`, `.second_name()`, `.common_name()`), the club, the opponent, the competition and a random(5); a club with reputation (`.reputation()`) below 5750, to the club's manager (`exe::news_send_to_club_manager`); otherwise, by random(3), to the division's managers (`exe::news_send_to_division_managers`) or to the country's (`.nation()`, `exe::news_send_to_nation_managers`).

Writes the headline or body of the ultimatum news, with the names and links of the manager and the clubs. \n `news_board_ultimatum_text(news, body, out)`: reads fields 0 to 7 of the news (`exe::newsitem_get_slot`: the manager, the three keys, the club, the opponent, the competition); the manager's name (`exe::database_format_staff_name`, 500, style 1). Body: text 0xa12dac in 0xde1f64 (`FN_LANGLIB_SPRINTF`) with the genders (the clubs' `.gender_name()`, the competition's `.short_gender_name()`), the names (the clubs' +4 / `club::NAME`, the competition's `competition::SHORT_NAME`) and the manager's, into `out` (`exe::text_set_string`), and the links (`exe::text_add_link`): the manager (0x7da, if the names match via `exe::database_staff_matches_names`), the club and the opponent (0x7d5). Headline: 0xa12d64 with the club's gender (`.short_gender_name()`) and short name (`club::SHORT_NAME`).

Posts the 0x1777 news with the manager, the club and the chairman; the reason by the board ratings below confidence − 500 (random draws of 3 and 5) and the rumour (random draw of 10, or 1 when the manager knows the club well); delivered to all, to the nation or to the division's managers; today's date into `board_record::LAST_REVIEW_DATE` of the board row. \n `MANAGER_MANAGER::post_manager_under_pressure_news(club, kind)`, called when considering sacking the manager (`consider_sacking_manager`: kind 1 when swapping for the best candidate, 2 after 14 days). Club without a manager (`.manager()`) or before the date `[G_GAME_START_DATE]` (`before_news_start_date`): nothing. News 0x1777 (`exe::new_newsitem`): the manager (0..3), the club (4), the chairman (`.chairman()`: 5..7 and the id in 10; without one, −1). The reason (8) from the board row (`.confidence()`): rating `.supporters_confidence()`, `.staff_confidence()` or `.confidence_4()` below confidence − 500 with random(3) zero gives 2, 1 or 3 (+1 with random(5) non-zero); otherwise 0. The kind (9) and the rumour (11): random(10), or 1 if the manager knows the club well (`exe::non_player_attribute_rating` of the non-player `.non_player()` with `.motivating()` above 10). Delivery (`deliver_news`): human manager, to all; club with reputation above 5000, to the country's; otherwise to those of the division (`.division()`) unless it is `[KEY_CLUB_COMP_A_LOWER_DIVISION]`. Finally today's date into the row's `board_record::LAST_REVIEW_DATE` (`exe::date_operator_3d`).

Posts the 6000 news with the manager, the kind, the club, the job, the chairman and the reason; a human manager with the names and to all; otherwise by the club (national team or reputation above 7250 to all, otherwise to the nation). \n `MANAGER_MANAGER::post_manager_departure_news(manager, kind, reason, club, job)`, called when removing the manager from the job (`remove_club_manager`). Null manager or club, before the date `[G_GAME_START_DATE]` (`before_news_start_date`) or kind 5: nothing. News 6000 (`exe::new_newsitem`): the manager (0..3), the kind (4), the club (5), the job (7), the chairman's keys (`.chairman()`: 8..10; without one, −1) and the reason (11). Human manager: his names from data slot 13 on (the next free one in 12, `news_set_manager_names`) and to all; otherwise by the club (`deliver_news_for_club`, `club_can_be_managed`; national team or reputation above 7250 to all, otherwise to the country's).

Posts the 0x1787 news of a manager appointment, only for a club of an active nation with an active division, or a national team of an active nation: the manager, the previous club, the club, the job and the previous role; delivered like the departure news. \n `MANAGER_MANAGER::post_manager_appointment_news(manager, previous, club, job)`, called from the manager market's day (0x68f9c0) and from the appointment (0x69ebc0). Null manager or club, before the date `[G_GAME_START_DATE]` (`before_news_start_date`) or job 5: nothing. Only a club of an active nation (the nation's `.league_selected()`) with its division in the array `[G_COMP_OBJECT_TABLE]`, or a national team (`exe::database_is_national_team`) of an active nation. News 0x1787 (`exe::new_newsitem`): the manager (0..3), the previous club (4; −1), the club (5), the job (6) and the previous role (7: `.job_for_nation()` for a national team, `.job_for_club()` for a club; without a previous one, −1). Human manager: the names from data slot 8 on (the next free one in 7, `news_set_manager_names`) and to all; otherwise by the club (`deliver_news_for_club`), like the departure news.

Returns the board's league confidence (`board_record::LEAGUE_CONFIDENCE` of the club's 0x49-byte record) in bands 0 to 6 (−2000, −1000, −500, 500, 1000, 2000). \n `MANAGER_MANAGER::get_league_confidence_band(club)`: the board's confidence in the league (signed word `board_record::LEAGUE_CONFIDENCE` of the club's 0x49-byte record in `[this]`) in bands: below −2000: 0; −1000: 1; −500: 2; 500: 3; 1000: 4; 2000: 5; otherwise 6. Used by the confidence text (0x690d80). Only `al` counts (the rest of eax is what was left from the address computation).
